title: Cognitive Automation, Labor Market Shifts & Reskilling
grammar: Assertive Evidentials and Epistemic Certainty in Economic Forecasting
goal: I can describe how automation changes work and why reskilling matters (*kognitív automatizáció, átképzés*).
I can refer to evidence with phrases such as *a kutatások tanúsága szerint* and *kétségkívül*.
I can discuss which jobs automation affects in formal Hungarian.
